title: jmap: wire Mailbox/query into route_method()
description: Why: Mailbox/query handler exists in crates/mail/src/mailbox/query.rs but is never called from route_method() in server.rs. JMAP clients that call Mailbox/query receive an unknownMethod error. What: Add a Mailbox/query arm to route_method() in server.rs that calls handle_mailbox_query(). The handler already accepts filters (isSubscribed) and sorting (name asc). No new logic needed — just wire the call and return the QueryResponse as JSON.
